title: One-open perfect descent with models at all later stages
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, R : I → CommRingCat a system of Noetherian rings, c a cocone, i an index, Xi a scheme and s : Xi → Spec R_i locally of finite presentation, quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Choose the shared derived categories [def-pc-derived-category]. Let W be an open of Xi with PerfectDescentOnOpen R c i Xi s W [def-pc-perfect-descent-on-open]. Let f : Z → Xi be an open immersion with W contained in its image and let E be perfect on X = Z times over Spec R_i Spec c.pt [def-pc-perfect-complex]. There exist j >= i such that for every k >= j, writing Y_k = Z times over Spec R_i Spec R_k, g_k : X → Y_k for the cocone base-change map, and U_k for the inverse image of W under Y_k → Z → Xi, a perfect object A_k on U_k has L(g_k restricted to U_k)* A_k isomorphic to the canonical exact open restriction of E to g_k inverse U_k [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. The statement has only one open and does not assert a cover or compactness.

source.place: Lemma 36.29.3, two-open induction: choose each local stage model and increase the index

proof.text: Put O = f inverse W and r = O.ι followed by f. The opensRange_comp and image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf identities show that r has image W. Construct q from the base change of O to the base change of Z by pullback.map. Pull E back along q; derivedPullback_preserve_perfect gives its perfectness. Apply PerfectDescentOnOpen to the presentation r and this perfect object, obtaining j, hij, Ej and a limit comparison.

For k >= j construct the arrow alpha from Spec R_k to Spec R_j in Over Spec R_i and the cocone arrows beta_j, beta_k. The cocone identity gives beta_k followed by alpha = beta_j. Pull Ej along baseChangeMap alpha to obtain B; pullback preserves perfectness. The baseChangeMap_comp identity and derived pullback composition turn its limit pullback into the original comparison with q pullback E.

Identify each inverse-image open with the corresponding base change of O via isoPullback of the pasted isPullback_morphismRestrict square and the defining base-change square. The private openBaseChange_transport lemma verifies the two projection equations for the restricted transition and for q. Pull B through the stage identification. Compose the two composition comparisons, the supplied limit comparison, the projection equalities, and singleComplexOpenPullbackIso to identify its limit pullback with exact open restriction of E. Finally rewrite inverse-image composition to match the displayed U. All scheme identifications and comparison objects are constructed, not chosen from mere existence.

proof_origin.place: Separate descent and stage enlargement in the two-open induction; explicit Lean pullback-square transport by M1, using 09UA and 0D5S and the existing canonical open pullback comparison.

lean.statement:
theorem perfect_descent_open_eventual_model
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) [∀ i : I, IsNoetherianRing (R.obj i)]
    (c : Cocone R) (i : I) (Xi : Scheme.{u}) (s : Xi ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation s] [QuasiCompact s] [QuasiSeparated s]
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (U : Z.Opens),
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (W : Xi.Opens) (dW : PerfectDescentOnOpen R c i Xi s W)
    (Z : Scheme.{u}) (f : Z ⟶ Xi) [IsOpenImmersion f] (hW : W ≤ f.opensRange)
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory (pullback (f ≫ s) (Spec.map (c.ι.app i))))
    (hE : (pullback (f ≫ s) (Spec.map (c.ι.app i))).IsPerfect E) :
    ∃ (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j), ∀ (k : I) (hjk : j ≤ k),
      let X := pullback (f ≫ s) (Spec.map (c.ι.app i))
      let g := baseChangeMap (f ≫ s)
        (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)))))
        (T' := Over.mk (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)))
        (Over.homMk (Spec.map (c.ι.app k))
          (by dsimp; rw [← Spec.map_comp, c.w (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk))]))
      let U := (pullback.fst (f ≫ s)
        (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)))) ≫ f) ⁻¹ᵁ W
      ∃ A : schemeDerivedCategory U.toScheme, U.toScheme.IsPerfect A ∧
        Nonempty ((derivedPullback (g ∣_ U)).obj A ≅
          (schemeOpenRestriction X (g ⁻¹ᵁ U)).mapDerivedCategory.obj E)
